title: Open Source Says No
excerpt: OSS projects banning AI-generated contributions, and a broader catalogue of AI contribution policies across the industry.
content_html:
yt-dlp

Banned

yt-dlp/yt-dlp

A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader

This project strictly forbids the usage of LLMs, agents, or any other AI tools for any kind of contribution.

GitHub

Category
Other

Scope
code, docs, issues, art, translations

Banned

meilisearch/meilisearch

We will not consider any content generated by generative AI tooling (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) in external contributions, including: code, tests, documentation, PR descriptions, PR comments, issue descriptions, and issue comments.
